# Servolia

> Servolia builds AI lead systems for independent service businesses, starting with dental practices and aesthetic clinics in France: a website written for the practice, an AI assistant that answers patients around the clock and takes their details, and a client area where every request lands. Fixed prices, published on the site, live in 7 days. Servolia also hosts small business websites.

Servolia is operated by Servolia LLC (Wyoming, USA). The French pages are the main market; the English pages describe the same service. Contact: hello@servolia.com.

## Prices (as published on the pricing pages)

- Setup: EUR 690 excl. VAT, paid once; the site and the AI assistant are live in 7 days.
- Monthly plans, by the number of AI conversations included: Essentiel EUR 149/month (100), Croissance EUR 249/month (300), Performance EUR 449/month (800). Every plan includes the 24/7 AI assistant; nothing is reserved for the higher plans.
- Free 7-day trial of the AI receptionist for dental practices, no card required: https://servolia.com/fr/essai
- Website hosting: Essential USD 6/month, Complete USD 8/month, Business USD 11/month (yearly prices give one month free).
